# App shell

> The application container: persistent navigation, header, and screen-corner chrome around changing page content, with one shared scroll policy.

Status: beta.

This file matches the installed `app-shell` source. The online docs follow the latest release and may describe a newer version.

## Install

```bash
npx shadcn@latest add https://control-ui.dev/r/app-shell.json
```

With `@ctrl-ui/react` instead of the registry, import from `@ctrl-ui/react/` where this file says `@/components/control-ui/`; this file then lives at `node_modules/@ctrl-ui/react/dist/docs/app-shell.md`.

## Registry dependencies

- `core`
- `page-layout`
- `sidebar`

## Exports

- `@/components/control-ui/knob-contracts/app-shell-corner-knobs`: `appShellCornerKnobs`, types `AppShellCornerKnobStyle`
- `@/components/control-ui/knob-contracts/app-shell-header-knobs`: `appShellHeaderKnobs`, types `AppShellHeaderKnobStyle`
- `@/components/control-ui/ui/app-shell`: `AppShell`, `AppShellContent`, `AppShellHeader`, `appShellCornerPlacements`, `AppShellCorner`, types `AppShellProps`, `AppShellHeaderProps`, `AppShellCornerPlacement`, `AppShellCornerProps`

## Composition

### Persistent application frame

AppShell includes SidebarProvider. Set scroll once: page uses the document, inset lets PageLayout scroll, and none lets workspace panes own scrolling. Keep the shell mounted while route content loads.

```tsx
<AppShell>
  <Sidebar>
    <SidebarContent />
    <SidebarRail />
  </Sidebar>
  <AppShellContent>
    <AppShellHeader>
      <SidebarTrigger />
    </AppShellHeader>
    <PageLayout>
      <PageHeader>
        <PageTitle />
      </PageHeader>
      <PageBody>
        route content
      </PageBody>
    </PageLayout>
  </AppShellContent>
</AppShell>
```

### Screen corners

Each AppShellCorner pins a tab of chrome to one screen corner, and the skin paints it. Corners stay visible when the sidebar collapses. While the sidebar is open, the start corners span its column and the column sits between them. Place corners in the DOM where they belong in the tab order. Hide one below the sidebar breakpoint with className when the page has no room for it.

```tsx
<AppShell>
  placement="top-start"
    <AppShellCorner>
      <SidebarTrigger />
    </AppShellCorner>
  placement="top-end"
    <AppShellCorner />
  <Sidebar>
    <SidebarContent />
  </Sidebar>
  <AppShellContent>
    route content
  </AppShellContent>
  placement="bottom-start"
    <AppShellCorner />
  placement="bottom-end"
    <AppShellCorner />
</AppShell>
```

## Usage

```tsx
"use client";

import { InboxIcon, SettingsIcon } from "lucide-react";
import { useState } from "react";
import { AppShell, AppShellContent, AppShellHeader } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/app-shell";
import { Avatar, AvatarFallback } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/avatar";
import { Button } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/button";
import { PageBody, PageHeader, PageLayout, PageTitle } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/page-layout";
import {
  Sidebar,
  SidebarContent,
  SidebarGroup,
  SidebarHeader,
  SidebarMenu,
  SidebarMenuButton,
  SidebarMenuItem,
  SidebarRail,
  SidebarTrigger,
} from "@/components/control-ui/ui/sidebar";
import { Skeleton } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/skeleton";
import { Text } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/typography";

export function PrimitiveAppShellExample() {
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  return (
    <AppShell layout="contained" scroll="inset" persistOpen={false} keyboardShortcut={null}>
      <Sidebar collapsible="icon">
        <SidebarHeader>
          <SidebarMenu>
            <SidebarMenuItem>
              <SidebarMenuButton size="lg" tooltip="Acme" render={<a href="/" />}>
                <Avatar size="xs" aria-hidden="true">
                  <AvatarFallback>A</AvatarFallback>
                </Avatar>
                <span>Acme</span>
              </SidebarMenuButton>
            </SidebarMenuItem>
          </SidebarMenu>
        </SidebarHeader>
        <SidebarContent>
          <SidebarGroup>
            <SidebarMenu>
              <SidebarMenuItem>
                <SidebarMenuButton isActive tooltip="Inbox">
                  <InboxIcon />
                  <span>Inbox</span>
                </SidebarMenuButton>
              </SidebarMenuItem>
              <SidebarMenuItem>
                <SidebarMenuButton tooltip="Settings">
                  <SettingsIcon />
                  <span>Settings</span>
                </SidebarMenuButton>
              </SidebarMenuItem>
            </SidebarMenu>
          </SidebarGroup>
        </SidebarContent>
        <SidebarRail />
      </Sidebar>
      <AppShellContent>
        <AppShellHeader>
          <SidebarTrigger />
          <Text size="label" mono className="min-w-0 flex-1 truncate">
            AppShellHeader
          </Text>
          <Button size="sm" onClick={() => setLoading(!loading)}>
            {loading ? "Show content" : "Show loading"}
          </Button>
        </AppShellHeader>
        <PageLayout width="content" aria-busy={loading}>
          <PageHeader>
            <PageTitle>Page content</PageTitle>
          </PageHeader>
          <PageBody>
            {loading ? (
              <div role="status" className="space-y-3">
                <span className="sr-only">Loading inbox…</span>
                <Skeleton className="h-5 w-48" />
                <Skeleton className="h-20 w-full" />
              </div>
            ) : (
              <Text as="p" tone="muted">
                AppShellContent holds the current page. Toggle loading to see the sidebar and header stay in place.
              </Text>
            )}
          </PageBody>
        </PageLayout>
      </AppShellContent>
    </AppShell>
  );
}
```

## Anatomy

Scopes, their parts, and the state attributes each part carries. Selector pattern: `[data-skin="{skin}"] :where([data-slot="{part}"][data-control-family="{family}"])`.

- `app-shell`
  - `corner`: `data-placement` (`bottom-end` | `bottom-start` | `top-end` | `top-start`)
  - `root`

## Knobs

Registered `--cui-*` custom properties with their recipe defaults. Set them through the component's `style` prop or a skin.

### app-shell-corner

- `--cui-app-shell-corner-size`: `calc(var(--control-h-md) + var(--spacing) * 3)`
- `--cui-app-shell-corner-inset`: `0px`
- `--cui-app-shell-corner-padding-inline`: `calc(var(--spacing) * 2)`
- `--cui-app-shell-corner-gap`: `calc(var(--spacing) * 2)`
- `--cui-app-shell-corner-background`: `var(--sidebar)`
- `--cui-app-shell-corner-background-image`: `none`
- `--cui-app-shell-corner-foreground`: `var(--sidebar-foreground)`
- `--cui-app-shell-corner-border-color`: `var(--sidebar-border)`
- `--cui-app-shell-corner-border-width`: `1px`
- `--cui-app-shell-corner-radius`: `min(var(--radius-panel), calc(var(--cui-app-shell-corner-size) / 2))`
- `--cui-app-shell-corner-shadow`: `0 0 transparent`
- `--cui-app-shell-corner-backdrop-filter`: `none`

### app-shell-header

- `--cui-app-shell-header-height`: `calc(var(--spacing) * 14)`
- `--cui-app-shell-header-padding-inline`: `calc(var(--spacing) * 4)`
- `--cui-app-shell-header-background`: `var(--background)`
- `--cui-app-shell-header-border-color`: `var(--border)`
- `--cui-app-shell-header-border-width`: `1px`
